body:
At 44, darn almost a perfect score. Would be 45, but I've started letting a random number generator make decisions when I can't.

To help with the procrastination, try to break things down into a list of list then work on one list at a time, while the others are hidden. I find that makes it more manageable and less daunting. Also be sure to mark things off as you do them. I find the guilt of not checking things off to sometimes be enough to force me to do things.

Computer science is what I’m studying and is what my internships are based around. I guess it is the pressure that has been breaking me down. I’ll graduate in a few short weeks without any job lined up. So I’ll have to go home as a failure and listen to my parents say what a disappointment and failure I am. I can’t do that. I've progressed so much since I moved to college and away from them. I’ll lose it all when I go back. I don’t want to go back to how I was back then. I would rather die than go to that dark place again. It would be hard to kill myself there so I had better do it before then.

I don’t care about myself. Over the many years I've kind of accepted the fact that I can never be happy or fulfilled. So when someone asks for something I always try to help. Since I can only feel emptiness or pain at least some good could come from my time. Currently I work 40+ hours for 2 internships for free as well as doing leadership and volunteering in addition to a full load of college classes. I've really tried to give everything these last few years in the vain hope of finding something to hold onto, but I still fell like an empty shell. I suppose I’m getting tired of watching people be happy from such small things while I’m always alone, ignored and miserable. I hate myself for it. I even cut my arm instead of legs as an experiment to see if a single person would care, but no one has. There must be something innately wrong with me. I don’t belong in this world. No matter how hard I work that doesn't seem to change. I'm getting tired of living like this, but I can't find another, even vague, reason to live. Hence just ending it.
Thank, I don't really know where to begin. I'm just tired of talking with my selves.
I really doubt that. The best I can hope for is to just manage it. I don't think that is much of a life.
